This page is a unit opener/introduction for Unit 4 Trigonometry. It contains: (1) the unit title "Unit 4: Trigonometry" prominently displayed, (2) a portrait illustration of the historical scientist Abou Alrayhan Albryrony, (3) introductory descriptive text about trigonometry as a branch of mathematics and its historical development, and (4) biographical context about key figures in trigonometry. These are characteristic unit opener elements—title page, image, and contextual/objective information—rather than lesson content (explanations, examples, exercises). The page serves as an introduction before the first lesson begins on page 49.
